title: The Motor Desk
cardDescription: Garage management system for car, bike and washing services — customers, vehicles, job tracking, billing, staff, salary and reports.
overview: The Motor Desk simplifies daily workshop operations for car, bike and washing services. It brings customers, vehicles, service jobs, billing, staff and business reports into one platform.
problem: Garages track customers, vehicles, jobs and payments in notebooks or scattered spreadsheets, so service history gets lost and billing is slow.
solution: A single dashboard for customer and vehicle records, service booking and job tracking, digital invoicing, payments, staff and salary management, and revenue reports.
result: Workshops keep full service history per vehicle, bill digitally, and see their revenue and service reports in one place.
features: Service booking, scheduling and job tracking
Digital billing, invoices and payment tracking
contributions: Worked on service tracking and billing
Built booking and invoicing API integrations
Worked on deployment and production improvements

challenges.challenge: Three different service lines (cars, bikes, washing) in one system.
challenges.solution: Modelled services by category so each line shares customers and billing but keeps its own job flow.

challenges.challenge: Finding a vehicle's past work quickly at the counter.
challenges.solution: Linked every job and invoice to the vehicle record to give an instant service history.
